modules.name: Visitor Management
modules.description: Records visitors, including walk-ins, and informs residents.

modules.name: Facility Booking
modules.description: Lets residents book facilities such as gym and pool by date and slot and shows live occupancy.

modules.name: Complaints
modules.description: Handles complaints raised by residents for their own flat.

modules.name: Notice Board
modules.description: Shows notices and events to residents for reading only.

modules.name: User and Role Management
modules.description: Covers creation of users such as Watchman, permissions, tenants and family lists.

modules.name: Society Setup
modules.description: Lets Raghuvir Admin configure flats, amenities and age groups.

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.description: Shows counts such as owner vs tenant families.

requirements.title: Record walk-in visitors
requirements.description: A walk-in visitor is recorded only and the resident is informed.

requirements.title: Book facilities by date and slot
requirements.description: Residents book facilities by date and slot in the app.

requirements.title: Live count inside gym and pool
requirements.description: Everyone can see the live count of people inside the gym and pool.

requirements.title: Support tenants
requirements.description: Tenants are allowed to use the system.

requirements.title: Send reminders instead of auto-closing
requirements.description: Complaints are not auto-closed; reminders are sent instead.

requirements.title: Configurable flats and amenities
requirements.description: The number of flats and amenities is not fixed and is set up by Raghuvir Admin.

requirements.title: Configurable age groups
requirements.description: Age groups are set by Raghuvir Admin.

requirements.title: Count tenant families
requirements.description: Tenant families are counted and the dashboard shows owner vs tenant.

requirements.title: Read-only notice board
requirements.description: The notice board is for reading only, with no event replies and no comments on notices.

rules.title: No approval for walk-in visitors
rules.description: Walk-in visitors need no approval from the resident.

rules.title: Who creates the Watchman
rules.description: Both Raghuvir Admin and Society Manager (with permission) can create the Watchman.

rules.title: Complaints limited to own flat
rules.description: Residents can raise complaints for their own flat only.

rules.title: Approval by permitted users
rules.description: Anyone given the permission by Raghuvir Admin can approve.

rules.title: Only resident edits family list
rules.description: Only the resident can edit the family list.
